Room: A room of the game's world map (a cave, a hall): a part of the level the player walks through. Not a hotel room.
Rooms: The rooms of the game's world map (a cave, a hall); a list or a tab. Not hotel rooms.
Gate: A door or passage that joins two rooms on the map (as in Hollow Knight). Not a garden gate.
Area: A named zone of the map that groups rooms, like Greenpath in Hollow Knight.
Areas: Named zones of the map that group rooms, like Greenpath in Hollow Knight.
Stamps: Decoration sprites placed on a room's walls and floors, as with rubber stamps.
Pin: A note marker that the designer pins on the map.
Pins: Note markers that the designer pins on the map.
Terrain: The solid ground and walls of a room.
Decor: Decorations on floors and under ceilings (grass, vines, stalactites).
Foreground: Drawn in front of the player.
Seed: A number that makes a random generator give the same result again.
Role: What a freeform style is used for (terrain, platform, background...).
Freeform: Drawn as free, curved shapes instead of on the tile grid.
Scenes: Godot scenes (.tscn files) of the game.
Boss: A boss enemy, or a room with one.
Bosses: Boss enemies, or rooms with one.
Save Points: Places where the player saves the game (benches).
Turn: Rotate a shape or a stamp by an angle.
Flip: Mirror a shape or a stamp.
Tag: A label attached to a room or a style.
Keep: Which room stays when rooms are merged.
Fit: Make a picture fit the room.
Fill: Cover an area with a fill (a solid color, tiles).
Place: A tool: put an object in the room.
Select: A tool: pick what is in the room.
Erase: A tool: remove what is under the brush.
Effects: Weather, hazards and scenery in motion (rain, lava, fog...).
Extend: A tool: make a room bigger.
Convert: Turn tiles into freeform shapes or the other way round.
Decorate: Add decorations to a room automatically.
Markers: Icons on the map for save points, bosses, shops...
Legend: The key that explains the colors and icons of the map.
Layer: A layer of the map or of a room.
Variation: Another random version of a generated cave.
Hanging: Stamps hung under ceilings and ledges.
